findings.effect_behavior: 32只BeetleThrasher组的原ActiveEffects均为slowness，amplifier=-1（目标NBT byte=255），duration=5，ambient=true，无粒子/图标；读取后target按同样条件映射为sleepLock并移除短期效果，以维持休眠控制，不是丢失效果。未发现其他实体效果负载。
findings.health_behavior: 113组都存在Health；readAdditionalSaveData先将loadedFromSave=true，再super读取目标NBT的Health/attributes/effects，随后配置重应用按min(savedHealth,maxHealth)保留存档生命值；新生成实体按maxHealth满血。
findings.random_spawn_bonus_behavior: 113/113组源NBT都存有follow_range上的Random spawn bonus；转换后各自UUID、amount、operation在target NBT保留。模板均以jigsaw_finalize_true加载：目标读取NBT后调用Mob.finalizeSpawn，再加入世界/onAdded，父方法以minecraft:random_spawn_bonus固定ID幂等追加；原1.20.1父方法每次finalizeSpawn也追加随机三角分布修饰符，故结构实体的旧存档修饰符+新生成修饰符两层与原来一致。后续世界存档读入不调用finalizeSpawn。动态新值无法静态知道。
findings.default_configuration: 107条保存属性与配置写入相交，均movement_speed，源/目标base与对应默认配置一致；Herald 6组未保存Attributes，supplier/config提供默认。全113组source ActiveEffects/Health与target对应字段都存在，32组Beetle slowness负一级由sleepLock映射。除同值情况外，仍发现3项注册属性默认值静态差异候选：Sunbeam ATTACK_DAMAGE 0→20；DormantMonolith ATTACK_KNOCKBACK 3→0.6；Herald ATTACK_KNOCKBACK 4→0.6。可配置本身满足用户要求，但若默认迁移要求保持原行为，应主线确认这是有意平衡还是默认缺陷；不属于107条直接保存movement_speed覆盖。KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE旧值Monolith=20/Herald=99超过原属性上限1，目标默认1有效值等价。
findings.runtime_limit: 无游戏/集成运行验证；静态顺序和映射已闭合。特定世界中的随机三角分布数值、实际AI表现及效果视觉效果只能运行时验证。

lifecycle.source_and_target_static_order: StructureTemplate.createEntityIgnoreException -> EntityType.create -> EntityType.create calls EntityType.create(level) then Entity.load(tag) -> LivingEntity.readAdditionalSaveData loads Attributes/ActiveEffects/Health; target subclass marks loadedFromSave before super and applies config after it returns -> StructureTemplate.finalizeSpawn if shouldFinalizeEntities=true -> ServerLevel.addFreshEntity -> onAddedToLevel -> later ServerLevel.tickNonPassenger invokes first Entity.tick/baseTick. 113/113 entrypoints are jigsaw_finalize_true.
lifecycle.target_finalizer: IceCreatureEntity.finalizeSpawn explicitly calls super; BeetleThrasher, DormantMonolith, ProtoiSunbeam, Herald inherit Mob.finalizeSpawn; concrete other family variants have own super-chain, but these 5 species use those listed paths. Every path reaches target Mob.finalizeSpawn, preserves an existing translated legacy modifier and adds fixed-ID random_spawn_bonus once.
lifecycle.source_finalizer: Ice species and BeetleThrasher, DormantMonolith, ProtoiSunbeam inherit old Mob finalizer. Herald old override calls super then HeraldOnInitialEntitySpawnProcedure to store HeraldX/Y/Zpos in persistent data. Target Herald has no finalizeSpawn override; target baseTick initializes anchor from current position when absent, so anchor creation moves from finalize to first tick but the existing target read fallback still consumes legacy saved coordinates.

attribute_application_sites.IceCreatureEntity.java: constructor -> readAdditionalSaveData after super -> onAddedToLevel -> each server tick before super.tick; loadedFromSave clamps saved Health to new max.
attribute_application_sites.BeetleCombatEntity.java: tick before super.tick -> readAdditionalSaveData after super -> onAddedToLevel; tick applies server-side config, loaded Health clamp.
attribute_application_sites.MonolithBaseEntity.java: readAdditionalSaveData after super -> onAddedToLevel -> every server tick before super.tick; loaded Health clamp.
attribute_application_sites.ProtoiSunbeamEntity.java: constructor -> readAdditionalSaveData after super -> onAddedToLevel; no tick retry, but with standard config lifecycle all config specs load before world-created entities. A world created before spec-loaded state is not statically modeled.
attribute_application_sites.HeraldEntity.java: constructor -> readAdditionalSaveData after super -> baseTick before super.baseTick; ManglerContent join event additionally calls applyConfiguredAttributes.

lifecycle.effects: The source NBT spells slowness amplifier as signed byte -1; target serialization encodes the same byte bit pattern as 255 and maps old Forge cure metadata to NeoForge cures. BeetleCombatEntity.readAdditionalSaveData recognizes exactly duration<=5, amplifier==255, ambient, invisible and maps to sleepLock then removes the inert marker; no other active effect groups exist.
